best_moments: host_0/1/3/6/8/11/12/13 correctly extract title + exact date/time from a single rich sentence — the one-shot drafter capability the original report called a 'hero moment' is real and reproducible
verdict: The host path's draft-authoring quality on rich single-sentence asks remains genuinely good and is the standout capability in the product. But the confirm-loop bug is completely unfixed at 16/16 (100%) — nobody in this rerun successfully posted a meet — and this run surfaced two concrete findings sharper than the original report: a literal ZIP-as-venue bug reproduced verbatim, and a date bug that lands two years in the past rather than a few days off.
